title: The Incidence and Risk Factors of Radiotherapy Induced Hypothyroidism in Head and Neck Cancer With Long Term Follow up
brief_summary: This is a retrospective study with long term follow up to evaluate the incidence, timing and risk factors of radiotherapy induced hypothyroidism in non-thyroid head and neck cancer patients who were treated with RT alone or in combination with surgery and/or chemotherapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non-thyroid head and neck cancer patients who were treated with RT alone or in combination with surgery and/or chemotherapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with thyroid gland disease or abnormal thyroid hormone levels before radiotherapy
